summary: Iteration 16 testing complete - Affiliate Self-Service Portal fully verified. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All new pages and components working correctly. Fixed a bug in commission recording where pack_id was used instead of unique payment_id for idempotency.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND BUG FIXED: credits/buy was using pack['id'] as ref for commission idempotency, causing only first purchase of each pack to record commission. Fixed to use unique payment_id.
BACKEND: POST /api/affiliate/primary-code correctly enforces one-shot rename with 400 error 'only change your primary promo code once'
BACKEND: Code uniqueness check works - returns 400 'already taken' or 'clashes' for duplicate codes
BACKEND: Code validation enforces 3-24 character range (422 for invalid length)
BACKEND: Auto-mint on reseller registration creates affiliate_codes row with U-prefixed 7-char code
BACKEND: GET /api/affiliate/me returns primary_code, primary_code_renamed, default_code correctly
BACKEND: Public attribution works - referral_code on registration sets referred_by to affiliate's user id
BACKEND: Commission recording works - affiliate_earnings created with kind='topup', model_used='time_window', status='earned', amount_usd=10% of pack price
BACKEND: Secondary codes CRUD works with 5 code cap enforced
FRONTEND: /reseller/dashboard renders AffiliateDashboard with hero card, primary code, share link, Copy button, 4 stat tiles, commission rules banner
FRONTEND: /reseller/codes renders AffiliateCodes with PRIMARY PROMO CODE block showing 'customised · locked' pill and 'Locked' icon for renamed codes
FRONTEND: /reseller/referrals renders table on desktop (data-testid='referrals-table') and card list on mobile
FRONTEND: /reseller/earnings renders earnings ledger with 4 status filter tabs (data-testid='earnings-tab-{key}') that filter rows correctly
FRONTEND: /reseller/payouts shows available amount, 'Request payout' button disabled when below $50 threshold
FRONTEND: /register?ref=RDEMO1 shows 'Promo applied' green banner, promo code field pre-filled and DISABLED
FRONTEND: /register without ?ref shows editable promo code field, no banner
FRONTEND: Mobile (390x844) - dashboard and earnings render without horizontal scrolling, tables convert to card lists
